scope: All 16 manifest capabilities reviewed for Linux applicability; 325 desktop requirements classified and 20 mobile-only requirements explicitly outside Linux scope. Counts measure candidate behavior, not completion percentage or release acceptance.

classification_rules.implemented: Candidate Linux behavior has automated production-path evidence; does not approve release, parity or human qualification.
classification_rules.partial: Some production behavior/evidence exists; full normative Linux requirement remains incomplete.
classification_rules.not-started: No native user flow found for the requirement; related generic helpers are insufficient.
classification_rules.blocked: Work requires the named human decision; underlying implementation status remains visible in the trace.
classification_rules.not-applicable: Explicitly outside Linux desktop scope, not a platform waiver.

outside_linux_scope.reason: SPEC Scope and relationship to desktop declares Android and iOS only. No mobile completion is claimed.

classification_changes.reason: Native temporary upload uses m_uploadBytes and UploadInput.fileBytes, not a managed temporary file. Core artifact resolution vectors alone do not establish native file lifecycle compliance.
Native after-capture selection shares the engine, but quick-task-menu and the full quick-action inventory have no native executor/entry surface.
Concurrent retained-media/counter tests exist, but complete temporary-file lifecycle and every native action family are not covered.
createTemporaryUploadFile encodes to QBuffer; native managed-file acknowledgement/cleanup/retention is not implemented as specified.
Declined confirmation semantics have injected Core vectors; the native executor has no before-upload-window branch or presentation flow.
Core delete guards have vectors, but CaptureActions has no native delete executor branch; domain guard tests do not prove a user-reachable deletion flow.
RegionSession supports quickConfirm false in Core, but CaptureController constructs default SessionSettings; the native workflow does not expose the contracted configurable confirmation mode.
RegionGeometry validates serialized last-region data in Core tests/vectors. CaptureController has no last-region persistence or acquisition route, so native round-trip capture is incomplete.

Full-name and fallback companion lookup exist with tests, but the contract explicitly requires baseline runtime observation before activation; no accepted observation is supplied by these automated fixtures.
Existing dialogs own cancellation and converter temporary cleanup, but absent QR scan/model sessions and complete utility lifecycle qualification prevent catalogue-wide completion.

verification_blockers.note: Local 114/114 gate passed; Ubuntu/Qt 6.4.2 compile failed on the newer QImage::flipped API. Corrective compatibility implementation and four independent pixel cases are prepared; exact corrective-revision baseline CI remains required.

Drawing API correction compiles on Qt 6.4.2; FileUploadTest used the newer floating-point drag-enter constructor. Fixtures now use the compatible integer point signature and retain all existing cases. Exact corrected-revision baseline verification remains required.

incremental_updates.outcome: Native workflow execution metadata review and confirmed unchanged-record removal are implemented and tested. Full retention and remaining capability behavior remain partial.

Native Save As offers PNG/JPEG/WebP with explicit quality, JPEG matte and extension validation. Actual worker encoding, source-preserving sidecars, format-aware repair and cancellation-boundary refusal are tested. Full codec/profile/target/fault and human qualification remain partial.

Native profile preferences expose quick confirmation and snapping with normative enabled defaults, field validation and Apply/Cancel/reset. Options freeze before portal acquisition; explicit confirmation enables existing keyboard adjustments. Interactive handles/presets, remaining fields and native target/human qualification remain partial.

Selected region corner handles are interactive with logical-coordinate hit-testing, persistent drag cursors, grab offset, Core positive-size/desktop clamps, resize announcements and explicit Enter confirmation. All corners at 1x/2x native scale and cancellation/actual output are tested. Optional presets and native target/accessibility qualification remain partial. RC-027 recapture requires an approved physical mapping source before pixel acquisition; no speculative recapture was added.

Native successful region screenshots persist version-1 geometry only through OwnedWork and PrivateJsonFile before actions. Existing malformed/newer/stale/unsafe records remain intact; compatible unknown fields round-trip. Metadata failures retain normal image outputs and stay visible even when workflow processing admission also fails. Storage and actual controller ordering/teardown/cancellation tests pass. Native recapture remains blocked on pre-acquisition physical topology authority; physical mapping/identity, crash and target qualification remain partial.

Native speech-balloon edit dialog provides asynchronous explicit commit/cancel for multiline text, font size and tail enable/tip coordinates. Existing points persist without a schema change. Tail-only edits commit once and undo/redo correctly; shared Core validation rejects invalid or overflowing mapped geometry. Regression evidence covers ignored tail changes, missing history admission for tip-only edits, and a real tiny-balloon renderer clamp assertion. State/selection/document and owner teardown tests pass. Font family/weight/italic/alignment/text color, creation/default breadth and physical qualification remain partial.

Text and speech balloons expose horizontal alignment in a shared asynchronous native text dialog. An optional per-object enum persists with legacy rendering retained when absent. Core rejects invalid creation/edit/import values, while unrelated annotation types preserve the same property opaquely. UI/history/reload and actual renderer glyph-placement tests cover both types. Font family, bold/italic, text colors, creation/default breadth and human target qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon Bold/Italic controls apply optional booleans as one undoable object edit. Legacy native styling remains unchanged when absent. Core persistence refuses invalid text field types and retains opaque same-named values on unrelated families. UI/history/reload and renderer glyph tests cover both types. Font family, explicit text color, creation/default breadth and human qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon text-color entry supports explicit #AARRGGBB and empty/default restoration independently of border/fill. Optional Core color persists canonically with alpha, including transparent zero; absence retains exact legacy rendering. Invalid entry/import cannot partially mutate the document. Tests cover native Apply/Cancel, no-op history, color-only undo/redo/reload, opaque fields on other types and actual alpha composition. Font family, creation/default breadth and target/human qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon font-family selection preserves unavailable saved names, renders them with the unchanged native fallback, and permits explicit installed replacements or default restoration as one history edit. Optional family strings persist without touching older documents. Core validates shape string/resource boundaries and retains opaque fields on other families. Native UI/history/reload, independent Qt glyph comparison and missing-font fallback tests cover both types. Reproduced/fixed QComboBox entry truncation from 100000 to 32767 characters. Creation/default breadth and target/human qualification remain partial.

Native Text and SpeechBalloon creation now opens full formatting controls asynchronously before any document mutation. Apply creates once from pointer-down geometry/style/state/selection; Cancel and empty entry create nothing. Shared completion fences document replacement, stale/disabled/dead owners and duplicate/deferred callbacks. Tests cover creation formatting, frozen defaults, undo/redo/reload, cancellation, focus transfer and teardown. Reproduced/fixed focus loss cancelling modal creation and old completed-dialog destruction clearing later modal pending state. Saved-default authority, remaining style breadth and human target qualification remain partial.

Selected Step numbers now edit asynchronously across the existing v1 0..1000000000 range, preserving previously clamped large values. Shared persisted/create/edit numeric bounds refuse invalid mutations. Text and Step reuse one guarded dialog completion path, retaining creation focus/cancellation behavior. Native tests cover boundaries, Apply/Cancel/no-op, history/reload, stale and dead owners, duplicate completion and deferred cleanup. Reproduced native 1000000 clamping and invalid create/edit admission before fixes. Alphabetic/Roman mappings and reset semantics are blocked pending product decisions; tail, defaults and full qualification remain partial.

Blur/Pixelate/Magnify/Spotlight native strength editing now uses owned asynchronous fractional input through shared guarded completion. Eight regressions reproduced integer rounding and zero/default materialization on unchanged Apply. The dialog preserves exact saved values when unchanged, including compatible values outside current native editing ranges; explicit edits retain those existing ranges and commit once. Native tests cover precision, Cancel/history/reload, stale/dead owners and deferred cleanup. Renderer behavior, persistence schema and default policy remain unchanged; full option and target qualification remains partial.
